player_prompt.intro:
Udla Mastermind.
Ufuna kupata ikhodi leyi ngiyiphi {code_length} idijithi elibi, kancinci yiya e {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ekuphendvula kwakho, unaweza kuthumela uthando wakho ngendlela leyi: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Emva kwesigamu sesikhathi, uthola ukubonga ngendlela yepigi elimnyama na elimhlophe.
Ipigi elimnyama ilinganisa digiti ngempela ngendlela leyi, ipigi elimhlophe ilinganisa digiti ngempela ngendlela leyi.
Una {max_turns} zesikhathi zokuthatha ikhodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Awukaphendvulanga ngekubeka luhla lwetinombolo letisemakhasini lahlukene.
invalid_move.not_integers: Konkhe lokungenile kumele kube tinombolo letinemandla.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tonkhe tinombolo kumele tibe semkhatsini wa-1 na-{num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Sewuvele wacabanga {guess}. Sicela wetame lokunye kucatjangwa.

game_action.feedback: Isubmitele [{guess}]. Imiklamo: {black_pegs} ipigi elimnyama, {white_pegs} ipigi elimhlophe.

outcome.win: Ufakile ikhodi, ukulungisa {black_pegs} kwe {code_length} amabhala ngempela
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wekugucuka ufinyelelwe. Ulingise kahle emaphesenti {percent} etinombolo.
